newsitem.title: USA: Garden Botanika says sales hurt shr price.
newsitem.headline: Garden Botanika says sales hurt shr price.

text.p: Garden Botanika Inc chief financial officer Myron Kirkpatrick said the company's disappointing August sales have hurt the company's stock price rather than its second quarter loss.
Garden Botanika, a retailer of personal care products that held an initial public offering in May, closed at 8-1/2, off 4-3/4, on 1.1 million shares traded.
The company's shares soared from its $20 a share initial public offering price to more than $30 in its first day of trading. The stock's high since the May offering is 35.
Kirkpatrick said the loss was expected by Wall Street analysts, who had a First Call consensus estimate of a loss of $0.19 a share.
Garden Botanika reported a net loss of $2.0 million for the quarter ended August 3, 1996, or $0.31 per share, compared to a net loss of $800,000, or $0.23 per share a year ago.
On a fully taxed basis, the company expects that its net loss would have been $0.18 a share this quarter and a loss of $0.14 a share in the year ago quarter.
Garden Botanika said it did not record an income tax provision in the second quarter of either year due to its operating loss carryforwards.
